legenda: Energetic Brazilian pop punk, fast and fun, male lead vocals singing in Brazilian Portuguese with gang vocal shouts, driving distorted power-chord guitars, punchy fast drums, melodic bass lines, half-time breakdown bridge, catchy singalong chorus, tight modern rock production, high fidelity, professional mix
inspiracao: Um pop punk acelerado sobre a pergunta se a IA torna a UML dispensável e sobre replicar o StructGen, com Designer, Coder e Pass@1.
descricao: Pop punk acelerado sobre se a IA ainda precisa de UML e a replicação do StructGen, do requisito ao código.
